scope: Final code-only publication tree, including explicit release configuration inputs. Representative scientific/runtime checks were executed during consolidation on the same retained implementation; complete experiments are excluded below.

tests.command: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m pytest tests/ analysis/tomov23/tests -x -q

quality_gates.lint_and_format: Final Ruff check passed; Ruff format left 78 files unchanged.

representative_checks.human_replay: Recorded human action-only replay executed successfully; no model API call required.

generic_feature_extraction.purpose: Actual CPU entrypoint/interface validation, not scientific feature reproduction
generic_feature_extraction.model: Locally initialized tiny Llama with a fast ChatML tokenizer

representative_checks.extraction_failure_status: Generic, V3.2 and V4 batch tests distinguish completed, skipped and failed sessions; continuation retains successful outputs while still failing the command when any selected session fails.
representative_checks.efficientzero: Bundled runtime and recovered extractor ran a small recorded trajectory on CPU and produced all requested layer traces; no private checkout was required. Final-paper checkpoint identity remains unresolved.
representative_checks.ddqn: Tiny CPU training/runtime check and recorded-trajectory extraction contract with explicitly synthetic weights; no performance-reproduction claim.
representative_checks.neural_integration: Synthetic NIfTI/confounds, base and LLM alignment, main/nuisance ridge fitting and ROI aggregation.
representative_checks.figures: Historical behavioral and neural figure commands ran against separately held tables; partial-table neural plotting also passed a headless synthetic smoke. Those tables are not included in this code release.
representative_checks.legacy_observation_generator: Lazy imports, CLI help and fake vLLM batching across files; no real vLLM GPU generation.

not_executed: Full fMRIPrep container execution on participant MRI.
Whole-cohort preprocessing and complete paper encoding fits.
Large-model GPU/distributed extraction or paper model-performance reproduction.
Complete proposed dataset staging, payload hashing or Hugging Face upload.
data_boundary: Detailed inventory, source-generation metadata, participant catalogues, historical tables and scientific payloads are maintained in the separate dataset release package, not this Git tree.
scientific_limitations: See scientific-provenance.md for unresolved checkpoint/layer attribution, coverage gaps and historical-condition distinctions.
dataset_package_validation: Separate local HF package loaded through its README configurations with datasets 4.8.5 using split=data. Both catalogue configurations loaded successfully; no remote upload was performed.
